_comment: Authoritative crawl targets for the daily scheme-refresh job.
Only *.gov.in / *.tn.gov.in and official scheme portals belong here — never news sites,
coaching portals or aggregator blogs. Those are useful for discovering that a scheme exists,
but figures must be confirmed against a source in this file before landing in schemes.json.
IMPORTANT FINDING (2026-09-07): the central tn.gov.in scheme directory only indexes 11
departments and does NOT include Health & Family Welfare, School Education or Higher
Education. Our two domains must therefore be crawled from the department portals below.
When adding another state or language, create a sibling file (e.g. scheme-sources-kl.json)
rather than merging — different portals, different refresh cadence, different source of truth.

sources.name: Tamil Nadu Government Portal — A–Z scheme directory
sources.notes: ~180 schemes, alphabet-filtered, no pagination. Detail ids are base64-encoded integers. Covers the welfare-department education scholarships (SC/ST, BC/MBC, minority) but NOT the Health or School Education departments.

sources.name: Adi Dravidar & Tribal Welfare / Social Justice — scheme list
sources.notes: Source of truth for SC/ST pre-matric and post-matric scholarships, free education up to Class 12, exam-fee assistance, hostels, book bank.

sources.name: BC, MBC & Minorities Welfare — scheme list
sources.notes: Source of truth for OBC/MBC and minority pre-matric, post-matric and professional-course scholarships.

sources.name: Health & Family Welfare Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
sources.notes: Departmental hub. Links out to the directorates (DPH, DMS, DME, TNMSC, TNHSP). Landing page itself lists directorates rather than schemes — crawl the directorate pages it links to.

sources.name: National Health Mission Tamil Nadu — programmes
sources.notes: Richest single health page: RMNCH+A, TAEI, communicable & non-communicable disease programmes, dialysis, cancer screening, mental health. Well structured and reliably server-rendered.

sources.name: Social Welfare & Women Empowerment Department
sources.notes: Source of truth for the Nutritious Meal Programme, Chief Minister's Breakfast Scheme, Pudhumai Penn, Cradle Baby Scheme and maternity benefits. Publishes exact beneficiary counts and per-meal nutrition figures.

sources.name: Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Higher Education Assurance Scheme (Pudhumai Penn) portal
sources.notes: Official scheme portal. Also the application entry point students should be pointed to.

sources.name: Directorate of Collegiate Education
sources.notes: Scholarship announcements are published as linked PDFs rather than HTML pages — the refresh job needs a PDF text extraction step for this source.

sources.name: Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme — official portal
sources.notes: AUTHORITATIVE for CMCHIS coverage/procedure/hospital figures, but the page is JavaScript-rendered and returns almost no content to a plain HTTP fetch. Needs a headless browser, or flag CMCHIS for manual verification. Secondary sources disagree badly on the procedure count (1,016 vs 1,416 vs 2,053) — do not trust them.

sources.name: Tamil Nadu Health Systems Project (TNHSP)
sources.notes: Implementing agency for CMCHIS and Innuyir Kaappom. Useful cross-check when cmchistn.com cannot be scraped.

sources.name: National Scholarship Portal
sources.notes: Central-government scholarships TN students are also eligible for (minority pre/post-matric). JS-rendered; low priority since state schemes dominate our traffic.

sources.name: myScheme — National scheme discovery portal
sources.notes: Government-run and genuinely comprehensive, but the listing is a client-rendered Next.js app with no documented public API — a plain fetch returns the shell only. Best used as a manual completeness audit target, not an automated crawl target.
